__inputs.label: A2VM reporting database

title: A2VM — which CVEs to fix first

list.name: tenant
list.label: Client
list.query: SELECT tenant AS __value, tenant_name AS __text FROM a2vm.latest_runs ORDER BY tenant_name
list.definition: SELECT tenant AS __value, tenant_name AS __text FROM a2vm.latest_runs ORDER BY tenant_name

list.name: snapshot
list.label: Snapshot
list.description: Each client's latest run on or before this day
list.query: SELECT to_char(d, 'DD Mon YYYY') || ' · W' || to_char(d, 'IW') AS __text, d::text AS __value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT generated_at::date AS d FROM a2vm.runs WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[])) s ORDER BY d DESC
list.definition: SELECT to_char(d, 'DD Mon YYYY') || ' · W' || to_char(d, 'IW') AS __text, d::text AS __value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT generated_at::date AS d FROM a2vm.runs WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[])) s ORDER BY d DESC

list.name: compare
list.label: Compared with
list.description: Earlier snapshot the counters are compared with
list.query: SELECT __text, __value FROM (SELECT to_char(d, 'DD Mon YYYY') || ' · W' || to_char(d, 'IW') AS __text, d::text AS __value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT generated_at::date AS d FROM a2vm.runs WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[])) s WHERE d < '${snapshot}'::date UNION ALL SELECT 'none', '') v ORDER BY __value = '', __value DESC
list.definition: SELECT __text, __value FROM (SELECT to_char(d, 'DD Mon YYYY') || ' · W' || to_char(d, 'IW') AS __text, d::text AS __value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT generated_at::date AS d FROM a2vm.runs WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[])) s WHERE d < '${snapshot}'::date UNION ALL SELECT 'none', '') v ORDER BY __value = '', __value DESC

list.name: scanner
list.label: Scanner
list.description: Detection sources that observed the finding
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT unnest(sources) FROM a2vm.decision_facts WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[]) ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT unnest(sources) FROM a2vm.decision_facts WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[]) ORDER BY 1

list.name: ptype
list.label: Product type
list.description: CPE part of the vulnerable product: application, os, hardware
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT product_type FROM a2vm.decision_facts WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[]) ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT product_type FROM a2vm.decision_facts WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[]) ORDER BY 1

options.content:
## Threats: which CVEs to fix first?
Snapshot **${snapshot:text}**, compared with **${compare:text}** — clients: ${tenant:text}. Counted in **distinct CVEs**; a CVE takes the most urgent decision among its findings.

panels.title: Distinct CVEs
panels.description: Distinct vulnerabilities of the snapshot. Arrow: change since the compared snapshot.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap (ord, snap_day) AS (VALUES (1, NULLIF('${compare}', '')::date), (2, '${snapshot}'::date)),
f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL a2vm.snapshot_runs(ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[], s.snap_day) r
  JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}))
,
c0 AS (SELECT f.ord, f.cve, min(f.level_rank) AS rank, bool_or(f.kev) AS kev, max(f.epss) AS epss,
  max(f.cvss_score) AS cvss, min(f.severity_rank) AS sev_rank, bool_or(f.fix_available) AS fix,
  count(DISTINCT f.asset) AS assets, count(*) AS exposures, min(f.title) AS title,
  string_agg(DISTINCT nullif(concat_ws(' ', f.vendor, f.product), ''), ', ') AS products
  FROM f GROUP BY f.ord, f.cve),
c AS (SELECT c0.*, (ARRAY['ACT', 'ATTEND', 'TRACK'])[c0.rank] AS level,
  (ARRAY['Critical', 'High', 'Medium', 'Low', 'Unknown'])[c0.sev_rank] AS severity
  FROM c0 WHERE (ARRAY['ACT', 'ATTEND', 'TRACK'])[c0.rank] IN (${decision:sqlstring}))
SELECT s.snap_day::timestamptz AS time, count(c.cve) AS value
FROM snap s LEFT JOIN c ON c.ord = s.ord
WHERE s.snap_day IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.ord, s.snap_day ORDER BY s.ord

,
c0 AS (SELECT f.ord, f.cve, min(f.level_rank) AS rank, bool_or(f.kev) AS kev, max(f.epss) AS epss,
  max(f.cvss_score) AS cvss, min(f.severity_rank) AS sev_rank, bool_or(f.fix_available) AS fix,
  count(DISTINCT f.asset) AS assets, count(*) AS exposures, min(f.title) AS title,

FROM snap s LEFT JOIN c ON c.ord = s.ord

,
c0 AS (SELECT f.ord, f.cve, min(f.level_rank) AS rank, bool_or(f.kev) AS kev, max(f.epss) AS epss,
  max(f.cvss_score) AS cvss, min(f.severity_rank) AS sev_rank, bool_or(f.fix_available) AS fix,
  count(DISTINCT f.asset) AS assets, count(*) AS exposures, min(f.title) AS title,
  string_agg(DISTINCT nullif(concat_ws(' ', f.vendor, f.product), ''), ', ') AS products
  FROM f GROUP BY f.ord, f.cve),
c AS (SELECT c0.*, (ARRAY['ACT', 'ATTEND', 'TRACK'])[c0.rank] AS level,

panels.title: SSVC decision × severity — CVEs
panels.description: Distinct CVEs of the snapshot per decision (most urgent finding) and CVSS rating.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap (ord, snap_day) AS (VALUES (2, '${snapshot}'::date)),
f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL a2vm.snapshot_runs(ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[], s.snap_day) r
  JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}))
,
c0 AS (SELECT f.ord, f.cve, min(f.level_rank) AS rank, bool_or(f.kev) AS kev, max(f.epss) AS epss,
  max(f.cvss_score) AS cvss, min(f.severity_rank) AS sev_rank, bool_or(f.fix_available) AS fix,
  count(DISTINCT f.asset) AS assets, count(*) AS exposures, min(f.title) AS title,
  string_agg(DISTINCT nullif(concat_ws(' ', f.vendor, f.product), ''), ', ') AS products
  FROM f GROUP BY f.ord, f.cve),
c AS (SELECT c0.*, (ARRAY['ACT', 'ATTEND', 'TRACK'])[c0.rank] AS level,
  (ARRAY['Critical', 'High', 'Medium', 'Low', 'Unknown'])[c0.sev_rank] AS severity
  FROM c0 WHERE (ARRAY['ACT', 'ATTEND', 'TRACK'])[c0.rank] IN (${decision:sqlstring}))
SELECT l.level AS "SSVC decision",
  count(c.cve) FILTER (WHERE c.severity = 'Critical') AS "Critical",
  count(c.cve) FILTER (WHERE c.severity = 'High') AS "High",
  count(c.cve) FILTER (WHERE c.severity = 'Medium') AS "Medium",
  count(c.cve) FILTER (WHERE c.severity = 'Low') AS "Low",
  count(c.cve) FILTER (WHERE c.severity = 'Unknown') AS "Unknown"
FROM (VALUES ('ACT', 1), ('ATTEND', 2), ('TRACK', 3)) l (level, o)
LEFT JOIN c ON c.level = l.level AND c.ord = 2
WHERE l.level IN (${decision:sqlstring})
GROUP BY l.level, l.o ORDER BY l.o

panels.title: … of which known exploited (KEV)
panels.description: The same CVEs, limited to those listed in CISA KEV.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap (ord, snap_day) AS (VALUES (2, '${snapshot}'::date)),
f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL a2vm.snapshot_runs(ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[], s.snap_day) r
  JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}))
,
c0 AS (SELECT f.ord, f.cve, min(f.level_rank) AS rank, bool_or(f.kev) AS kev, max(f.epss) AS epss,
  max(f.cvss_score) AS cvss, min(f.severity_rank) AS sev_rank, bool_or(f.fix_available) AS fix,
  count(DISTINCT f.asset) AS assets, count(*) AS exposures, min(f.title) AS title,
  string_agg(DISTINCT nullif(concat_ws(' ', f.vendor, f.product), ''), ', ') AS products
  FROM f GROUP BY f.ord, f.cve),
c AS (SELECT c0.*, (ARRAY['ACT', 'ATTEND', 'TRACK'])[c0.rank] AS level,
  (ARRAY['Critical', 'High', 'Medium', 'Low', 'Unknown'])[c0.sev_rank] AS severity
  FROM c0 WHERE (ARRAY['ACT', 'ATTEND', 'TRACK'])[c0.rank] IN (${decision:sqlstring}))
SELECT l.level AS "SSVC decision",
  count(c.cve) FILTER (WHERE c.severity = 'Critical' AND c.kev) AS "Critical",
  count(c.cve) FILTER (WHERE c.severity = 'High' AND c.kev) AS "High",
  count(c.cve) FILTER (WHERE c.severity = 'Medium' AND c.kev) AS "Medium",
  count(c.cve) FILTER (WHERE c.severity = 'Low' AND c.kev) AS "Low",
  count(c.cve) FILTER (WHERE c.severity = 'Unknown' AND c.kev) AS "Unknown"
FROM (VALUES ('ACT', 1), ('ATTEND', 2), ('TRACK', 3)) l (level, o)
LEFT JOIN c ON c.level = l.level AND c.ord = 2
WHERE l.level IN (${decision:sqlstring})
GROUP BY l.level, l.o ORDER BY l.o

panels.title: CVEs to fix first
panels.description: Distinct CVEs of the snapshot, most urgent first: decision, known exploitation, EPSS, CVSS. Since: new since the compared snapshot, or the decision it had then.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap (ord, snap_day) AS (VALUES (1, NULLIF('${compare}', '')::date), (2, '${snapshot}'::date)),
f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL a2vm.snapshot_runs(ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[], s.snap_day) r
  JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}))
,
c0 AS (SELECT f.ord, f.cve, min(f.level_rank) AS rank, bool_or(f.kev) AS kev, max(f.epss) AS epss,
  max(f.cvss_score) AS cvss, min(f.severity_rank) AS sev_rank, bool_or(f.fix_available) AS fix,
  count(DISTINCT f.asset) AS assets, count(*) AS exposures, min(f.title) AS title,
  string_agg(DISTINCT nullif(concat_ws(' ', f.vendor, f.product), ''), ', ') AS products
  FROM f GROUP BY f.ord, f.cve),
c AS (SELECT c0.*, (ARRAY['ACT', 'ATTEND', 'TRACK'])[c0.rank] AS level,
  (ARRAY['Critical', 'High', 'Medium', 'Low', 'Unknown'])[c0.sev_rank] AS severity
  FROM c0 WHERE (ARRAY['ACT', 'ATTEND', 'TRACK'])[c0.rank] IN (${decision:sqlstring}))
SELECT cur.cve AS "CVE", cur.level AS "Decision", cur.severity AS "Severity",
  round(cur.cvss::numeric, 1) AS "CVSS", round(cur.epss::numeric, 3) AS "EPSS",
  CASE WHEN cur.kev THEN 'yes' ELSE '' END AS "KEV", CASE WHEN cur.fix THEN 'yes' ELSE '' END AS "Fix",
  cur.assets AS "Assets", cur.exposures AS "Exposures",
  CASE WHEN NULLIF('${compare}', '') IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN prev.cve IS NULL THEN 'new' WHEN prev.level <> cur.level THEN 'was ' || prev.level ELSE '' END AS "Since",
  cur.products AS "Product", cur.title AS "Vulnerability"
FROM c cur LEFT JOIN c prev ON prev.cve = cur.cve AND prev.ord = 1
WHERE cur.ord = 2
ORDER BY cur.rank, cur.kev DESC, cur.epss DESC NULLS LAST, cur.cvss DESC NULLS LAST,
  cur.assets DESC, cur.cve
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Distinct CVEs per decision, day after day
panels.description: Each day: the CVEs of each client's latest run that day (dashboard time range).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, count(DISTINCT x.cve) FILTER (WHERE x.cve_level = 'ACT') AS "ACT", count(DISTINCT x.cve) FILTER (WHERE x.cve_level = 'ATTEND') AS "ATTEND", count(DISTINCT x.cve) FILTER (WHERE x.cve_level = 'TRACK') AS "TRACK"
FROM (SELECT x.day, x.cve, (ARRAY['ACT', 'ATTEND', 'TRACK'])[min(x.level_rank)] AS cve_level
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (tenant, generated_at::date) run_id FROM a2vm.runs
  WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND $__timeFilter(generated_at)
  ORDER BY tenant, generated_at::date, generated_at DESC) r
  JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}) GROUP BY x.day, x.cve) x
WHERE x.cve_level IN (${decision:sqlstring})
GROUP BY day ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Products with the most CVEs
panels.description: Distinct CVEs of the snapshot per vulnerable product, most urgent first.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap (ord, snap_day) AS (VALUES (2, '${snapshot}'::date)),
f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL a2vm.snapshot_runs(ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[], s.snap_day) r
  JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}))
,
c0 AS (SELECT f.ord, f.cve, min(f.level_rank) AS rank, bool_or(f.kev) AS kev, max(f.epss) AS epss,
  max(f.cvss_score) AS cvss, min(f.severity_rank) AS sev_rank, bool_or(f.fix_available) AS fix,
  count(DISTINCT f.asset) AS assets, count(*) AS exposures, min(f.title) AS title,
  string_agg(DISTINCT nullif(concat_ws(' ', f.vendor, f.product), ''), ', ') AS products
  FROM f GROUP BY f.ord, f.cve),
c AS (SELECT c0.*, (ARRAY['ACT', 'ATTEND', 'TRACK'])[c0.rank] AS level,
  (ARRAY['Critical', 'High', 'Medium', 'Low', 'Unknown'])[c0.sev_rank] AS severity
  FROM c0 WHERE (ARRAY['ACT', 'ATTEND', 'TRACK'])[c0.rank] IN (${decision:sqlstring}))
SELECT coalesce(c.products, 'unknown product') AS "Product",
count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.level = 'ACT') AS "ACT", count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.level = 'ATTEND') AS "ATTEND", count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.level = 'TRACK') AS "TRACK"
FROM c WHERE c.ord = 2 GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.level = 'ACT') DESC, count(*) DESC LIMIT 15
